title: ZMS enum values and GraphQL filter inputs from the Python SDK

prose.text: The SDK defines the enum values and filter inputs the ZMS queries use; no GraphQL schema is published to confirm them ([[zms.api:schema]]).

enum-agent-connection-status.statement: `AgentConnectionStatus` has the values CONNECTED, DISCONNECTED, ERROR and UNKNOWN.

quotes: class AgentConnectionStatus(str, Enum): """Agent connection status enum.""" CONNECTED = "CONNECTED" DISCONNECTED = "DISCONNECTED" ERROR = "ERROR" UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"

class DefaultPolicyRuleScopeType(str, Enum): """Default policy rule scope type enum.""" CUSTOMER = "CUSTOMER"

policy-vs-default-action.statement: Custom policy rules can carry SIM_BLOCK, which default policy rules cannot: `PolicyAction` has it and `DefaultPolicyRuleAction` does not.
policy-vs-default-action.conditions: Comparison of the two enum classes at the pin; what SIM_BLOCK does is not stated by any source.

origin-enums-differ.statement: Resource-group origin (`ResourceGroupOrigin`: ML_RECOMMENDED, USER_DEFINED) and tag-namespace origin (`NamespaceOrigin`: CUSTOM, EXTERNAL, ML, UNKNOWN) are separate value sets, and `tagValues` needs the namespace one.
origin-enums-differ.conditions: Comparison of the two enum classes; the tagValues argument type is in zms.api.queries:tag-hierarchy.

string-expression.statement: String filters are `StringExpression` objects with `contains`, `ends`, `equals`, `in` (from `in_list`) and `starts`.

integer-expression.statement: Integer filters are `IntegerExpression` objects with `eq`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in` and `between`.

resource-filter.statement: `ResourceQueryFilter` filters on id, name, status, resourceType, cloudProvider, cloudRegion and platformOs.

resource-groups-filter.statement: `ResourceGroupsFilter` filters on id, name, resourceHostname and resourceId.

policy-rule-filter.statement: `PolicyRuleFilter` filters on id, name and action.

app-zone-filter.statement: `AppZoneFilter` filters on id, appZoneName and description.

app-catalog-filter.statement: `AppCatalogQueryFilter` filters only on id, name and category, narrower than the portal's application name, category, process, protocol and port filters.

quotes: Filter the information by Application Name, Application Category, Process, Protocol, and Port.

tag-filters.statement: Tag filters are `NamespaceFilter` (name, origin), `TagKeyFilter` (keyName, valueName) and `TagValueFilter` (name).

order-by.statement: In the SDK's ordering inputs, resources, namespaces, tag keys and tag values order by name with a `SortDirection` value, app zones by appZoneName with a plain string, and app catalog by name, category, creationTime or modifiedTime.
